acceptance: PiRpcClient stores, from the handshake and before PiRpcSession::new consumes it: the models (id, name, provider), the thinking levels, the current model id, the current thinking level. New public methods (all take &self): `config_options(&self) -> Vec<SessionConfigOption>`; `applied_model(&self) -> String` (the current model value, "provider/id"); `set_model(&self, value: &str) -> Result<(), String>`; `set_thinking_level(&self, level: &str) -> Result<(), String>`

config_options returns exactly two select options. (1) id "model", name "Model", category Model, one SessionConfigSelectOption per Pi model with value "provider/id" and name = the model's name (fall back to id when name is empty), current value = the model whose id equals the handshake model_id (first match; if none match, the first model; if there are no models, return no model option). (2) id "thought_level", name "Thinking", category ThoughtLevel, one option per thinking level (value and name both the level), current value = the current thinking level (if it is not in the list, the first level; if there are no levels, omit this option). The values reflect the latest successful set_model / set_thinking_level

set_model splits value on the FIRST '/' into provider and modelId (no '/' -> Err("model must be provider/id")), calls session.request("set_model", json!({"provider":..,"modelId":..}), 10s), and on Ok updates the stored current model to value; Err passes Pi's error text through. set_thinking_level calls request("set_thinking_level", json!({"level": level}), 10s) and on Ok stores the level. Both return Err when the session has been shut down

Usage: when wait_event gets PiStep::RunFinished, it first asks `session.request("get_session_stats", json!({}), USAGE_TIMEOUT)` with `const USAGE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2)`; if that returns Ok data with numeric data.contextUsage.tokens AND data.contextUsage.contextWindow, it builds the usage event `AcpClientEvent::SessionUpdate(Box::new(SessionNotification::new(session_id, SessionUpdate::UsageUpdate(UsageUpdate::new(tokens, window)))))`, pushes the RequestFinished event onto the BACK of event_queue and returns the usage event first, so usage is delivered before the finish. If the request fails or the numbers are missing, behave exactly as today (return RequestFinished directly). The request id clearing logic is unchanged

pi_rpc_client_options_tests.rs (declared in mod.rs as `#[cfg(test)] mod pi_rpc_client_options_tests;` next to pi_rpc_client_tests) tests: config_options shape and current values (model category Model with current "fake-provider/fake-model" and 2 options; thought_level category ThoughtLevel with current "medium" and 4 options); set_model success updates applied_model() and the model option's current value; set_model on "fake-provider/does-not-exist" -> Err containing "Model not found" and state unchanged; set_model("nopslash") -> Err; set_thinking_level("high") updates the option's current value; prompt flow delivers events in this order: AgentMessageChunk, UsageUpdate with used 10362 and size 1000000, RequestFinished (all matched with the same 10s waits); with `--silent-stats` the RequestFinished still arrives and no usage event precedes it
